summary: The PR addresses an inconsistency in the behavior of the `mincnt` parameter in `hexbin` when the `C` parameter is provided. The proposed change aligns the behavior with the case where `C` is not provided.

issues.description: The change may introduce behavioral regression risk as it alters the behavior of `hexbin` when `C` is provided. Existing code relying on the current behavior could break.
There are insufficient tests to verify the new behavior across different scenarios and edge cases. Additional tests should be added to ensure the change does not introduce regressions.
